Avoid photorealism, gradients, shadows, decorative robots, giant title, tiny text, watermark, figure number, or external caption. Keep about 3% safe margins and compact balanced composition. This is a planned study, not observed results. Topic: context-dependent trust risks. Compose two aligned areas.
Upper 52%: comparative educational scenario with two small refined line-art vignettes (teacher at board and learner doing exercise). Center a small document headed “相同完整解答” with mini formula/solution-line illustration (no numerical claim), branching to two context cards: left labels “教师演示”“允许展示完整步骤”“可允许”; right labels “独立练习”“仅允许提示与引导”“可能超界”. Show that task rules change the meaning of the SAME answer.
Lower 40%: a connected process strip of three detailed miniatures, not plain boxes: magnified retrieved document “检索证据” with warning tag “来源失真”; tool-call window “工具行动” with lock and tag “权限越界”; memory database “记忆更新” with marked entry and tag “污染延续”. Direct thin arrows connect the three stages. A slim evidence strip below reads “来源与引用 → 调用参数与回执 → 记忆读写记录”. A modest footer conclusion, navy, says “结合教学情境与行为过程判断风险”. Visually link upper scenario rules to lower evidence assessment with a subtle bracket; do not imply every tool sequence is unsafe.
